review.description: S1–S4 retain verified signed callback subscriptions and metadata-only inbox/attention notifications while replacing retired run.state discovery with session.changed. Existing retry/expiry/rotation semantics remain unchanged. C7 S4 metadata-only source alerts include changed signed webhook observations independent of matching agent rules; duplicate/no-change deliveries do not repeat alert.

Public payloads retain only entity/kind; private summaries/questions never enter callback bodies. Native questions replace recovered textual-question notification sources. Read processDelivery source update and inbox.changed in the same transaction; no source body enters the notification payload.
review.tests: Read TestSubscriptionVerificationRetryDedupRefreshAndExpiry, TestCallbackSafetyAndFailedChallenge and updated TestPRMonitoringAndSessionQuestionsUseMetadataOnlyNotifications. The latter checks inbox, native attention and session callbacks once each and excludes private text. Real Work callback acceptance stays an open gap. Read actual signed handler→Poll→events.Tick subscriber test with matching and nonmatching rules, committed currenthead/body, one alert then same-ID and new-ID/unchanged-source silence, no privatebody or native turn. This is fixture webhook delivery, not installed-host acceptance.
